QuestInfo.name: Council President's Order 1
QuestInfo.0: Council President #bAnthony#k in #bEdelstein#k has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Anthony asks you to bring 10 Amethyst Ores to help develop Edelstein. You can obtain Amethyst Ore much more easily if you have Mining skill...\n\n#i4020001##t4020001#  #b#c4020001# / 10#k
QuestInfo.2: You brought Amethyst Ores to Anthony.

0.0: No, no, no...this is no good! Maybe if I move some funds out of the schools... Oh, who goes there? What? Quiet, I'm trying to balance Edelstein's budget! Do you have any idea how much it costs to run a city?
0.1: I'd hike up taxes, but if I did that those Resistance ruffians would start a ruckus. What to do, what to do... Hmm... Hey, why don't you help? Think of it as your civic duty!

yes.0: Of course! You're a good citizen, aren't you? If you can bring me #b10 Amethyst Ores#k, that should help fill the city coffers! Think of the children!
yes.1: You do know where to get Amethyst from, of course? Just mine for them using your Mining skill. Don't give me that look! If you aren't a Miner, just buy them from one!

no.0: Don't pin this budget shortage on me! I may be council president, but that doesn't make me responsible!

1.0: Oh, this is pure Amethyst! Fantastic! You truly are a model citizen! Pwahaha! Huh? Of course I won't reward you. Civil service is its own reward! PWAHAHA!

item.0: No, I asked for #b10 Amethyst Ores#k. Just mine for them using your Mining skill. Don't give me that look! If you aren't a Miner, just buy them from one!
